text.style: font-size: 21px; font-family: 'TradeGothic LT Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #191919

g.text: Persistent prediction errors reveal where all three models struggle

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'Source Serif Pro'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Consensus is the mean saved spatial nested-CV residual. All methods agree on the error sign in 85–90% of observed tracts, depending on outcome.
Notes: Residual = observed minus spatial nested-CV prediction; positive means participation exceeded prediction. Consensus averages saved PLS, supervised-PCA, and Elastic Net residuals—no refits.
The two originally missing outcomes were imputed upstream for modelling and are deliberately grayed here.
Sources: final saved CT model results and observed variables; canonical 2021 CT geometry; City of Toronto ward geometry.
